title: Bergamot Silk (Sake Cocktail)
headnote: DRAFT / UNTESTED FINAL VERSION — Egg-free revised Bergamot Silk from October 18, 2026. Makes two cocktails. Earlier February version used egg white; this version deliberately omits it. Lemon is adjusted to taste.

ingredientGroups.title: For 2 cocktails
items: 30 ml fresh lemon juice to start (1 oz); add up to 7.5 ml more (¼ oz) if too sweet

steps: Chill two coupe or Nick & Nora glasses.
Add the sake, bergamot syrup, elderflower liqueur, 30 ml fresh lemon juice, Peychaud’s bitters, and optional saline to a cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake briskly for 10–12 seconds, then fine-strain evenly into the chilled glasses.
Taste for balance before repeating the batch. If too sweet, increase lemon to a total of 37.5 ml (1¼ oz) per two cocktails.
Serve without egg white; this is the finalized egg-free direction, not the earlier February egg-white build.
